goal: Find net-new, AI-core mobile app ideas for high-frequency everyday activities that large numbers of women regularly do, ranked by NOVELTY (white space; no strong AI-native incumbent) x USERBASE (how many women, how often) multiplied together. Prefer low-friction app-store distribution, viral/organic growth, bounded per-use cost, short path to first revenue, credible path to 1-5M+/yr.

review.note: Novelty genuinely high (no AI-native live braid coach; only try-on filters + static tutorials; TressTechnique/ReelMind weak). BUT headline mechanism overclaims VLMs (Gemini Live <=1FPS/2min, resolution curse blocks strand-level, QEVD-FIT-COACH unsolved). Passes only rescoped to COARSE step/progress/pacing coaching. Testable via Wizard-of-Oz.

No shipping incumbent does true live closed-loop corrective makeup coaching (YouCam/Vella/FaceFlow are try-on or after-the-fact critique; Stylingmate is prescriptive not corrective). Wedge open. USERBASE very high (90M, daily). Feasibility is the risk: VLMs weakest on faces/small objects/fine spatial + 3-4s latency; degrade to single-error-class MVP. Novelty moderate x userbase very high clears bar.

Camera-CV doming/breath-hold for postpartum core is largely unoccupied (DiastaFix=scripted chatbot; general form apps=skeletal pose only), BUT contested by well-funded Hinge Health (camera-CV MSK + pelvic program) & Sword Bloom (sensor) who own distribution. Feasibility: breath-hold + pelvic-tilt feasible; soft-tissue doming is the weak sub-claim (occlusion, VLM hallucination). Wellness-disclaimer regulatory path proven by incumbents. Rescope: lead with breath+tilt.
